done_when: The cap counts only Python files under src/forge against a ceiling of 7,000 in pyproject.toml, an accepted decision records the owner's choice, the tests and the v1 spec say so, and the full test suite passes

findings.body: The required end-to-end proof is missing. This test implements the count directly; its Forge invocation at tests/test_rules.py:70 only requests help. The other changed test likewise calls `--help` and checks the configuration value. Neither exercises enforcement through Forge's command, as the review contract requires. Add an acceptance test that exercises the real check path and demonstrates that non-Python growth is accepted while Python growth beyond 7,000 lines is rejected.
findings.title: Not done: Python-only line-cap enforcement through Forge's command

why: Forge's 8,000-line cap counts its text templates with its Python, so every story must cut lines first and trims delete useful comments
